-- Named sets, their products, cardinalities and finiteness (SPEC.md, "Finite sets").
-- Each test is admitted once and never changed (scripts/check_acceptance_permanent.py).

test sets.card.z4_cubed "Mathlib Fintype.card_fun, ZMod.card: |(ℤ/n)^k| = n^k":
  assert |(ℤ/4)^3| = 64

test sets.card.z7 "Mathlib Fintype.card_fun, ZMod.card: |(ℤ/n)^k| = n^k":
  assert |(ℤ/7)^1| = 7

test sets.card.z5_empty_power "Mathlib Fintype.card_fun: |X^0| = 1":
  assert |(ℤ/5)^0| = 1

test sets.card.integers "Mathlib Cardinal.mk_int: |ℤ| = ℵ₀":
  assert |ℤ| = ℵ₀

test sets.card.naturals "Mathlib Cardinal.mk_nat: |ℕ| = ℵ₀":
  assert |ℕ| = ℵ₀

test sets.card.fin2_times_z3 "Mathlib Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin, ZMod.card: 2 · 3":
  assert |Fin(2) × ℤ/3| = 6

test sets.finite.integers "Mathlib Int.infinite: ℤ is infinite":
  assert ℤ.is_finite() = false

test sets.finite.fin2_times_z3 "Mathlib Finite.instProd: a product of finite sets is finite":
  assert (Fin(2) × ℤ/3).is_finite()

test sets.implemented.card_fin "a realization computes |Fin(3)|":
  assert implemented |Fin(3)|

let A := Fin(2) × ℤ/3

test sets.card.square "Mathlib Fintype.card_prod: |A × A| = |A|², |A| = 6":
  assert |A × A| = 36

test sets.card.fin2_sqcup_fin3 "Mathlib Fintype.card_sum: |Fin 2 ⊔ Fin 3| = 5":
  assert |Fin(2) ⊔ Fin(3)| = 5

test sets.finite.fin2_sqcup_fin3 "Mathlib Finite.instSum: a coproduct of finite sets is finite":
  assert (Fin(2) ⊔ Fin(3)).is_finite()

test sets.eq.rev_rev "Mathlib Fin.rev_rev: reversing Fin n twice is the identity":
  assert rev(3) ∘ rev(3) = id(Fin(3))

let f := {0 ↦ 0, 1 ↦ 1, 2 ↦ 1} : Fin(3) → Fin(2)

let g := {0 ↦ 1, 1 ↦ 0} : Fin(2) → Fin(2)

test sets.limit.pullback.card "Mathlib Types.pullbackLimitCone: {(x, y) | f x = g y} = {(0,1), (1,0), (2,0)}":
  assert |pullback(f, g)| = 3

test finite_sets.card.three "Mathlib Fintype.card_fin: |Fin 3| = 3":
  assert |Fin(3) in FiniteSets| = 3

let f' := {0 ↦ 0, 1 ↦ 1, 2 ↦ 1} : (Fin(3) in FiniteSets) → (Fin(2) in FiniteSets)

let g' := {0 ↦ 1, 1 ↦ 0} : (Fin(2) in FiniteSets) → (Fin(2) in FiniteSets)

test finite_sets.limit.pullback.card "Mathlib Types.pullbackLimitCone, created by FintypeCat ⥤ Type: 3 pairs":
  assert |pullback(f', g')| = 3

test sets.apply.rev "Mathlib Fin.rev: rev 0 = 2 in Fin 3":
  assert rev(3, 0) = 2 in Fin(3)

test sets.apply.rev_rev "Mathlib Fin.rev_rev: rev (rev 1) = 1 in Fin 4":
  assert rev(4, rev(4, 1)) = 1 in Fin(4)
